title: Accounting and Tax Services for Dietitians

rows.before: We modelled the break-even, incorporated a Dietetic Professional Corporation with the CDO Certificate of Authorization, moved her goodwill and equipment across on a section 85 rollover, then set a salary-and-dividend mix within the TOSI rules and funded an Individual Pension Plan so active income taxed at 12.2% under the $500,000 small business deduction stayed working for her.
rows.after: We modelled the break-even, incorporated a Dietetic Professional Corporation with the CDO Certificate of Authorization, moved her goodwill and equipment across on a section 85 rollover, then set a salary-and-dividend mix within the TOSI rules and funded an Individual Pension Plan so active income taxed at 11.2% (12.2% before July 1, 2026) under the $500,000 small business deduction stayed working for her.
rows.note: Case-study result stated without a date as the current SBD-taxed rate; treated as current. If Sharad dates this engagement before July 1, 2026, switch to R3 (leave).
